column1: # PAIRS chain coefficients (fracMove, fracR, fracMoveTorq) by condition. Read by softbox.PairsTable (-pairs-table).
# Why a table: the chain law relaxes a fixed fraction per step, so its effective stiffness is k = f*gamma/dt and a
# coefficient set tuned at one (eta, dt) does not transfer to another. With gamma proportional to eta, the discrete
# chain map depends on the condition only through dt/eta (per-step spring move = f*strain; per-step Brownian move =
# sqrt(2kT*dt/gamma)), so a row matches any (eta, dt) with the same dt/eta, at the same monomers per segment.
# That is the scaled-dt invariance (CLAUDE.md, viscosity Stage 1). Lookup never interpolates: no matching row is an error.
#   mono        monomers per segment (segLength = (mono+1)*actinMonoRadius); SiteNormal uses 64
#   eta_Pa_s    viscosity at which the set was tuned
#   dt_s        stepping dt at which it was tuned
#   brown_dt_s  Brownian dt at tuning. SoftBox applies Brownian every step, so only rows with brown_dt_s == dt_s match
#   lp_softbox_um  Lp measured in SoftBox (DiffusionHarness -lp ... -pairs-table) at this row's condition; '-' = not yet
#   source         where the numbers came from
